title: Saving the checklist recomputed it from the current archive instead of the brief's dev commit
resolution: The text names its dev commit and --save needs --at, which ranks the archive as of that commit through git; unknown commits are refused.

title: A fixed cutoff date did not implement changes started after this change lands
resolution: Changes need checklist.json when their .openspec.yaml was first committed after the commit that archives this change, or is uncommitted.

title: Validation accepted impossible checklist records: counts above totals, duplicate or unranked categories, an invalid time
resolution: Added consistency checks for time, unique ranked categories within top, and baseline counts, each with a negative test.

title: Saving to the reserved archive name passed the active-change check
resolution: Only real active change directories other than archive are accepted; the refusal writes nothing.

title: The Makefile comment said validate takes --json
resolution: The comment now names only index, reviewers, and effect as taking --json.

title: Without --at the checklist ranked the working tree archive but named the merge-base dev commit
resolution: With a readable dev commit the checklist ranks that commit's archive; otherwise it ranks the tree and names no commit.

title: A shallow clone made every active change look opened after the landing
resolution: A shallow clone skips the requirement; the full-clone pre-push make verify enforces it.

title: A failed git listing or read yielded an empty archive that could be ranked and saved
resolution: archiveSnapshot returns undefined when the listing or any file cannot be read.

title: The effect looked up findings by change name, so a reused name took the first archive's findings
resolution: Findings are looked up by archive directory.

title: An unreachable save check duplicated the parser's --at requirement
resolution: The command type makes --at required with --save, and the check is gone.

title: The checklist schema did not mention --at and described devCommit as the merge base
resolution: The schema names --at and describes devCommit as the brief's dev commit.

title: The usage text showed --at as optional with --save
resolution: The usage lists the listing and the saving form separately, with --at required for --save.

title: The living requirement said the checklist ends with Record quality, though it now ends with the dev commit line
resolution: A MODIFIED Findings index and checklist delta names the dev commit line, with a scenario.

title: Proposal, verification, and design claimed the text checklist output was unchanged
resolution: They now say the output gains the dev commit line.

title: The verification revision omitted the dev merges and gave counts of an older tree
resolution: The revision names both merges and the counts were rerun on the current tree.

title: The effect test git helper lacked commit.gpgsign=false and duplicated another helper; findings tests used the real git environment implicitly
resolution: One shared git fixture without hook variables and with signing off; findings tests inject a no-git environment.

title: No test covered a change opened before the landing on a branch that later merges it, or an unknown --at with --save
The coordinator's brief duties were only in docs and skills
resolution: The agent-task-protocol delta adds Checklist in the brief.

title: A change with zero changed lines read no per 100 changed lines
